Garment Background Studio — Phase 2 Test Images

Use these images to test:
1. white garment against light background
2. black garment against dark background
3. patterned garment
4. garment with a logo
5. hoodie with shadow
6. patterned dress
7. tank top with fine/curved edges
8. garment against a busier background

For Phase 2, manually mask the garment, replace the background, and verify:
- garment appearance is preserved
- the selected background replaces only masked-away pixels
- edges do not show obvious halos
- undo/redo and polygon/brush correction work
